# SomeScript - Visual LaTeX Editor & AI Writing Suite

> SomeScript is a modern visual LaTeX editor powered by AI (Eve assistant) and the Tectonic compilation engine.

## Overview
SomeScript combines a rich CodeMirror-based LaTeX editor with real-time PDF preview powered by `@embedpdf/react-pdf-viewer`, bidirectional SyncTeX navigation, and embedded AI collaboration tools.

## Key Features
- **Visual LaTeX Editing**: Syntax highlighting, autocompletion, and live rendering.
- **Tectonic Compiler**: Fast, on-demand package downloading and compilation without full TeX Live setup.
- **SyncTeX Integration**: Instant jump between editor code lines and compiled PDF positions.
- **Eve AI Writing Assistant**: Embedded AI workspace for drafting, proofreading, and generating LaTeX structures.
- **Monorepo Architecture**: Clean separation between landing site, compiler service, editor core, and documentation.
